Hello sir, and thanks for letting me post here. I've been working on this site + hardware for 4 months with bits of time I have off work, a labor of love. Open to any questions, comments, suggestions, etc :)

Well, I'll start you off with some questions!

  • What kind of RasPis do you use?

  • Is Marvin the only one that's tethered? If so, why is that?

  • Do you have the RC car source code available? Seems like a fun little project!

Hey,

(1) So I'm using the RasPi 2 B with a Wifi dongle plugged in for wireless. Motor controller is from Adafruit. The RasPi 3 came out a bit after I built them... of course it would have had Wifi built in..

(2) Yeah Marvin is tethered because he's the first one I made, and it was just easier that way. Also it helps to have one robot on all the time without the need to switch out batteries. Currently I have to manually keep all the batteries charged/swapped out for the others. I'm thinking about some auto-charging station stuff but haven't gotten to it yet..

(3) Yup, the code on the robots is open source here: https://github.com/runmyrobot/runmyrobot This does the motor control and sends video. It essentially sends and responds to socket.io messages.. :)

-rick
